# forgebase_storage_bucket (Data Source)

Looks up a storage bucket by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forgebase_storage_bucket" "avatars" {
  name = "avatars"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docgen; do not edit by hand (run `go generate ./...`) -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_content_types` (Set of String) Allowed content types, if restricted.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Unused in data sources.
- `id` (String) The bucket name.
- `max_object_bytes` (Number) Size limit in bytes, if any.
- `owner` (String) Creator.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant, if any.
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.
- `versioning` (Boolean) Versioning is on.
- `visibility` (String) `private`, `authenticated` or `public`.
